review.imagery: Twenty own-project renders were visually reviewed. Seventeen native brochure scenes and three distinct current-gallery angles cover the complete building, facade, pool courtyard, lobby, homes and leisure spaces. Four embedded generic beach/people resources and duplicate current-gallery crops are excluded. The whole-building exterior supplies the card and hero. Views and interior fitout are proposed and unit-unspecific. No construction photographs or badges are added.
review.floorPlans: Four complete home drawings are from the official brochure. Five complete building sheets are from a Mitchell’s Commercial Realty mirror of the SAMANA-branded plan pack. The three-bedroom drawing explicitly excludes a pool. Numeric unit areas and approved home-to-unit matching are unavailable. Confirm the selected unit and contractual area with SAMANA. All official home sheets on physical pages 32–35 and all mirror floorplates on physical pages 2–6 were visually reviewed. The mirror’s printed grouping is 2nd/4th on page 4 and 3rd/5th on page 5. The podium parking and two three-bedroom units remain visible. No missing area or matching key is invented.
review.location: Complete original travel panel page 9 and regional map page 10 were visually reviewed. The map’s visible Dubai Islands marker is preserved. Hidden template road text is not adopted as a waterfront access claim. The official project-name map query is recorded with source hash. Published driving ranges remain estimates, and the unnamed metro entry is explicitly omitted.
review.provenance: Fresh primary HTML and original official brochure retain source receipts and hashes. Supplementary floorplates are honestly labeled as a broker-hosted mirror. Original bytes, native image origins, complete sheets and physical page links are preserved. This is Ocean Pearl, separate from Ocean Pearl 2. Protected ownership and completed text research remain intact.

unavailable: Drawing-specific numerical unit areas, approved home-to-unit mapping, final fitout, verified entrance coordinates, identified metro service and dated construction photographs were not established.
